blocks.text: Grandview Heights market snapshot (as of September 2026)

parts.t: The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board doesn't publish a separate benchmark for Grandview Heights. It reports
as one area. These are its
(MLS® Summary, White Rock / South Surrey), released October 5, 2026. Benchmark = MLS® Home Price Index benchmark.

By my calculation, September sales were about 10% of active listings for detached homes, 17% for townhouses and 14% for apartments. FVREB describes 12% to 20% as a balanced market. Area-wide figures can differ a lot from any one street or home, so ask me for recent Grandview Heights sales.

Townhouses had the largest year-over-year benchmark decline of the three property types in this area. That matters in Grandview Heights, where townhouses were the most-sold property type over the past 12 months (see below).

Is "Grandview Surrey" the same as Grandview Heights?

Yes, for practical purposes. "Grandview Surrey" is the MLS® sub-area name used for the listings on this page, and Grandview Heights is the City's name for the planning area. It's in South Surrey, not Vancouver's Grandview-Woodland.
Which high school serves Grandview Heights?
Every address I checked from about 21 Avenue north returned Grandview Heights Secondary. An address on 165A Street, between 18 and 20 Avenue, returned Earl Marriott. Check the specific address.
No. The City's Morgan Heights plan describes Southridge as a private school. It sits at the centre of the Morgan Heights neighbourhood but isn't part of the Surrey School District.
Is there still new development coming?
Yes. Redwood Heights and Darts Hill were listed as pending servicing, and Area 5 is only starting its planning process, with a draft plan expected in 2027 under the City's timeline.
Are townhomes cheaper here than a year ago?

Across South Surrey & White Rock, the townhouse benchmark was $797,100 in September 2026, down 11.2% from September 2025. In the Grandview Surrey sub-area, the median townhouse sale was $833,000 over the 12 months to Sep 29, 2026 and $799,900 over the last six months (past sales, see the table above). Individual complexes vary with age, size and location.
